draft.title: Stereotypes and prejudice
card: an oversimplified idea about a group, which is applied to everyone in it. It ignores the differences between individuals.
a judgement made about a person without knowing them, usually because of the group they belong to. It can be negative or positive.
A stereotype is an idea about a group. Prejudice is a judgement about a person. A stereotype can lead to prejudice when someone uses it to judge a person they have not met.
Both can lead to unfair treatment, such as being left out, not being hired or being treated with suspicion. Getting to know the person as an individual challenges both.
draft.remember: A stereotype oversimplifies a group. Prejudice judges a person before knowing them.

a.q: Which statement is an example of a stereotype?
opts: "Teenagers are all lazy and glued to their phones"
"I did not enjoy the food at that café"
"Most buses in Perth run on time in the morning"
"My neighbour Sam has lived in Cairns for ten years"
a.why: The first statement applies one simple idea to every teenager and ignores individual differences. The others describe a single experience, a general pattern or a fact about one person, and do not oversimplify a whole group.
a.clue: Look for the idea that is applied to everyone in a group.

b.q: Dev manages a shop. He rejects Aisha's job application without an interview because he thinks people her age are unreliable. What is this?
opts: Prejudice, because he judged her without knowing her
A stereotype only, because no one was treated unfairly
Prejudice, because he got to know her as an individual
Neither, because he made the decision as a manager
b.why: Dev judged Aisha before knowing her, based on an oversimplified idea about her age group. That is prejudice, and it led to unfair treatment. His role as manager does not change this, and the stereotype was acted on, so it did cause harm.
b.clue: Did Dev know anything about Aisha herself before deciding?

a.best: "Teenagers are all lazy and glued to their phones"

b.best: Prejudice, because he judged her without knowing her
